title: VERY THIN MATERIAL
text: VERY THIN MATERIAL. Very thin material. Will purchase a more substantial one when I can. I would suggest using a large safety pin on each corner and secure it to the box spring to ensure it doesn't move around too much. Be careful when pulling it into place as the material could rip. Mine didn't but I can see where it could happen quite easily. Be gentle.
